description: This file defines a base class 'Barcode' and several subclasses for different barcode types (e.g., I2of5, MSI, Codabar, Code11). It includes methods for validation, encoding, decomposition, size computation, and drawing of barcode symbols, utilizing the reportlab library for PDF generation.

classes.name: Barcode
classes.description: Abstract base class for barcode types, providing common methods for validation, encoding, size calculation, and rendering.

classes.name: MultiWidthBarcode
classes.description: Base class for barcodes with variable width bars, such as Code93 and Code128.

classes.name: I2of5
classes.description: Implementation of the Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode, numeric-only, with specific encoding patterns and options.

classes.name: MSI
classes.description: Implementation of the MSI barcode, numeric-only, with checksum options and size parameters.

classes.name: Codabar
classes.description: Implementation of the Codabar barcode, supporting start/stop characters and various options.

classes.name: Code11
classes.description: Implementation of the Code 11 barcode, encoding digits and dash with checksum options.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing barcode parameters and options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value for encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the validated value into barcode pattern.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Decomposes the encoded value into a pattern for drawing.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the barcode for rendering.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the barcode onto a canvas.

methods.name: rect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle shape for barcode bars.
